title: The Giver of Stars
author: Jojo Moyes
summary: In 1930s Kentucky, a young English bride joins a travelling library of women who deliver books on horseback to isolated mountain families. The work brings friendship and plenty of local opposition.
readIf: you want a warm, uplifting historical novel about women, books and close friendships.
skipIf: you want much historical depth; it is a comfortable, plot-driven read that simplifies many issues.

pairings.reason: Another American story that makes the landscape a character and has a quiet, romantic heart.
A comparable ensemble story of brave women in a prejudiced American community.
A more comic story of a woman who stubbornly does her own thing in a world not ready for her.
